notes: Empty alias inventory emits the C header and None line.
Deleting an unknown trigger emits No such alias.
A replacement is inserted at the head and acknowledges Alias added.
Listing uses C's fifteen-column trigger field and stored leading replacement space.
ALIAS_SIMPLE replaces the complete input and discards text after the trigger.
Redefinition removes the old node, inserts the new node at the head, and says Alias added.
Deleting an existing trigger removes it and emits Alias deleted.
The management command refuses the reserved alias trigger.
ALIAS_COMPLEX expands semicolon-separated commands in order with C command-cycle framing.
$1 substitutes the first post-trigger token and preserves C's token limit.
$* substitutes the complete original text after the trigger.
Alias creation collapses doubled dollar signs before classifying and persisting the replacement.
Replacements longer than 120 bytes emit the warning and store the C-truncated value.
